title: Lock in sync
description: Schema-first contract of the lock-in-sync preflight: before any capacity wait, store custody or installer, every dependency scope's lock file is compared with the manifests of its members; a stale lock is refused at once, naming the scope, the members that changed and the exact command that regenerates it, in every offered language. The installer's own refusal of a frozen install is translated into the same text.

frozenRefusalPatterns.bun: lockfile had changes, but lockfile is frozen

en.stale: The lock file of dependency scope {scope} is out of date: Bun would refuse its frozen installation, but only after the build has waited in its queue. Changed: {changes}. Regenerate the lock, review its diff and run the command again: {command}
en.refused: Bun refused the frozen installation of dependency scope {scope}: its lock file no longer matches its manifests. Static comparison: {changes}. Regenerate the lock, review its diff and run the command again: {command}
en.unexplained: no manifest difference found, a resolved package changed
en.workspace-missing: {member} is a member the lock does not list
en.workspace-stale: {member} is listed by the lock but is no member
en.stale-in-lock: {member} no longer declares {section} {dependency}, which the lock still lists

de.stale: Die Lock-Datei des Abhängigkeits-Scopes {scope} ist veraltet: Bun würde ihre eingefrorene Installation verweigern, aber erst nachdem der Build in seiner Warteschlange gewartet hat. Geändert: {changes}. Lock neu erzeugen, den Diff prüfen und den Befehl erneut ausführen: {command}
de.refused: Bun hat die eingefrorene Installation des Abhängigkeits-Scopes {scope} verweigert: Die Lock-Datei passt nicht mehr zu den Manifesten. Statischer Vergleich: {changes}. Lock neu erzeugen, den Diff prüfen und den Befehl erneut ausführen: {command}
de.unexplained: kein Manifest-Unterschied gefunden, ein aufgelöstes Paket hat sich geändert
de.workspace-missing: {member} ist ein Mitglied, das der Lock nicht führt
de.workspace-stale: {member} steht im Lock, ist aber kein Mitglied
de.stale-in-lock: {member} deklariert {section} {dependency} nicht mehr, der Lock führt es noch
